# Controlled scanner acceptance corpus

These deliberately unsafe exports are inert fixture code. Nothing in Embermend
imports or starts them. Run them only in the disposable acceptance sandbox.
They provide separate application ownership, relationship context, source-only
coverage, injection, path handling and authorization defects. Their directory
and revision must be explicitly selected; finding them in a fixture is not a
claim about another application or production exposure.

The acceptance workflow prepares reviewed fixes in isolated workspaces and
retains independent exploit-prevention tests. A repeated model opinion is not
validation. Do not weaken the product's gates to accept a fixture result.
